name: Piwigo
description: Core self-update extracts a ZIP over HTTPS with only a 'file size > 0' check. PEM extension installer shares the gap.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Core update downloads the zip in chunks and extracts it into the application; the flow only checks transfer/extraction results, not a cryptographic signature.
limitations: Source-at-commit evidence only; released artifacts and external framework enforcement were not independently verified.

original_evidence.text: | Piwigo | https://github.com/Piwigo/Piwigo.git | cb1a748 / 2026-07-31 | Y | Y (admin-triggered, one click; also a scheduled notify-only version check) | Y | http+https mixed: core self-update fetches over `PHPWG_URL` (https, `fetchRemote()` uses curl with no `CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER`/`VERIFYHOST` override → TLS enforced by curl defaults); extension/PEM catalog config default (`PEM_URL`) is also https by default | none | payload integrity check is **filesize>0 only** — no hash, no signature | N/A (server-supplied zip, unauthenticated) | `admin/include/updates.class.php:502-645` (`updates::upgrade_to()`: downloads update zip in base64 chunks from `PHPWG_URL.'/download/dlcounter.php?code=...'`, writes to disk, then `PclZip::extract()` straight into `PHPWG_ROOT_PATH` — only check before/after is `filesize($filename)` truthy and per-file extract status, no hash/signature); `include/common.inc.php:219` (`PHPWG_URL = 'https://'+PHPWG_DOMAIN`); `admin/include/functions.php:2445-2515` (`fetchRemote()` curl, no TLS-disable flags found). **Side channel (score separately, C-equivalent):** plugin/theme "PEM" extension installer also downloads+extracts zips with the same no-signature model — `admin/include/plugins.class.php:655-671` (`extract_plugin_files` → `PclZip`), `admin/include/updates.class.php:273-372` (`get_server_extensions()` against `PEM_URL`). |
